base_dn.description: Root Distinguished Name (DN) of the LDAP directory to search.

bind_dn.description: DN of the account used to bind to the LDAP server. Leave blank for anonymous bind.

bind_password.description: Password for bind_dn. Not required if using bind_password_file or SASL.

bind_password_file.description: Path to file containing bind password (e.g., /etc/debian-edu-router/.ldap-passwd). More secure than embedding password.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying the LDAP server's TLS certificate.

cache_enabled.description: Enable result caching to reduce LDAP queries and improve performance.

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached LDAP entries. Set to 0 to disable caching.

client_cert_file.description: Optional client certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication.

client_key_file.description: Optional client private key for mTLS.

group_attrs.description: LDAP attributes to fetch for group entries.

group_filter.description: LDAP search filter for groups. '{{groupname}}' is replaced with the group name.

group_search_base.description: Subtree to search for groups. If empty, defaults to base_dn.

home_dir_template.description: Template for generating user home directories. '%u' is replaced by username; '%{uidNumber}' uses UID attr.

keytab_file.description: Path to Kerberos keytab for SASL/GSSAPI authentication.

ldap_uris.description: One or more LDAP server URIs (space-separated). Supports ldap:// and ldaps://. Prefer ldaps:// for encryption.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs to syslog.

max_uid.description: Maximum UID to accept — prevents conflicts with Windows SID-based UIDs > 1M in AD integrations.

min_gid.description: Minimum acceptable GID (to exclude system groups).

min_uid.description: Minimum acceptable UID (to exclude system accounts like root, daemon).

nested_groups.description: Whether to recursively expand nested group memberships (e.g., for Active Directory or complex group hierarchies).

sasl_principal.description: GSSAPI service principal name (e.g., host/router.example.com@REALM). Required for Kerberos auth.

shell_template.description: Shell path to assign if user loginShell attribute is missing or empty. Can use '%s' for loginShell value.

sizelimit.description: Maximum number of entries to return per search (0 = unlimited).

ssl_mode.description: Security mode for LDAP connections: 'simple' (plain), 'starttls' (upgrade to TLS), 'off' (no TLS). Use 'starttls' or 'simple' with ldaps://.

sudo_cmd_attr.description: LDAP attribute containing allowed commands (e.g., ALL).

sudo_enabled.description: Enable sudo rule fetching from LDAP/AD.

sudo_filter.description: LDAP filter for sudo rules. '%u' is replaced by the user’s login name.

sudo_runas_attr.description: LDAP attribute specifying which user to run as (e.g., root).

sudo_search_base.description: Subtree to search for sudoRole entries (e.g., ou=SUDOers,dc=example,dc=com).

user_attrs.description: LDAP attributes to fetch for user entries. Required for home directory, shell, UID/GID mapping.

user_filter.description: LDAP search filter for users. '{{username}}' is replaced with the login name during lookup.

user_search_base.description: Subtree to search for users. If empty, defaults to base_dn.
